fixes_applied.title: Add #[serde(default)] to ProgressAssessmentProposal.blockers
fixes_applied.description: blockers field now defaults to empty Vec when omitted from LLM output. This was the primary root cause of ProgressAssessmentProposal parse failures — the schema did not list blockers in required, but the Rust struct required it.

fixes_applied.title: Add recommendation field to ProgressAssessmentProposal
fixes_applied.description: Schema requires 'recommendation' field but Rust type was missing it. Added as optional String with #[serde(default)].

fixes_applied.title: Fix schema: add blockers to required array
fixes_applied.description: Added 'blockers' to the JSON schema required array so LLM always outputs it.

fixes_applied.title: Soften evaluator prompt fence instructions
fixes_applied.description: Changed from 'Do NOT use markdown fences' to 'Prefer raw JSON. Fences will be stripped automatically.' Reduces LLM confusion.

fixes_applied.title: Enforce max_evaluator_invocations with durable count
fixes_applied.description: Before spawning evaluator provider, count durable evaluator invocations from planner_invocations table. If count >= max_evaluator_invocations, skip provider spawn. Survives crash/restart.
key_changes: Durable count query BEFORE provider spawn
Budget exhaustion → skip evaluator (no provider spawn)
Retry loop within remaining budget for transient errors

fixes_applied.title: Add count_durable_evaluator_invocations helper
fixes_applied.description: Reads COUNT(*) FROM planner_invocations WHERE goal_id = ? AND invocation_kind = 'evaluator'. This is the authoritative budget counter.

fixes_applied.title: Add is_evaluator_error_retryable classifier
fixes_applied.description: Classifies errors: ProcessTimeout → retryable; SerializationError/InvalidState → NOT retryable; Internal → heuristic (provider failure retryable, harness defect not).
